rows.en:
(I came to the convenience store for a
late-night snack. Is there anything else
I should pick up?)

Out this late at night? Ooh, naughty, naughty~
I'm gonna tattle to Sensei tomorrow~

Hey, Hoshimura.
But you're just as guilty, aren't you?
Oh, now that you mention it, I guess so...
Then let's both keep it a secret!

Sure, sure.
So what'd you come to the store for, Hoshimura?

Me, I got hungry, so I came to buy snacks.
What about you?
I got hungry too, s......
rows.notes: Deliberately cut off mid-word (the Japanese breaks off in 'kara'); Yui interrupts with her misunderstanding.

rows.en:
Oh, sorry, that was a tactless thing to ask...
You're sneaking out to a convenience store
at this hour. A healthy boy can't help it...
rows.notes: Yui assumes the male player is secretly buying something racy; the implication is kept as vague as the Japanese.

rows.en:
Yup, you and I never met.
So let's just say I have no idea what
you were trying to buy!
What are you talking about, Hoshimura?
Mm-hm, see ya!

(What on earth did she get the wrong idea
about? Honestly, that Hoshimura...)

(I came to the convenience store for a
late-night snack. Is there anything else
I should pick up?)

Oh, Yui.
But you're just as guilty, you know?

Sure, sure.
So what'd you come to the store for, Yui?
I got a little hungry too, so...

You're quite the daredevil yourself, huh?
Snacking at this hour.
You're doing the same thing, Yui, aren't you?
Urk! Well, yeah, but...
Just a little should be okay, right?
Probably...

Then don't sweat it, don't sweat it!
See ya!

(Just a little should be okay...
right......?)

(So these are the scars of the battle...
I had no idea the damage was this bad......)
Why did it have to come to this, huh...
So you came here too, Hoshimura...

All we're doing is looking for a planet we can
live on... So why... why did this happen...!
Hoshimura...

Sorry... I ended up dumping
all my whining on you...
Don't worry about it.

There's no use moping around forever, right!
Let's go at it with a full tank of energy,
enough to fix this whole town in one go~!

Yeah, that's it. You're way better when
you're full of energy, Hoshimura.

Right? Energy's my selling point, after all!
Alrighty~! Bring it onnn~!

(Even if she's only putting on a brave face,
that's better than being gloomy right now...)

(So these are the scars of the battle...
I had no idea the damage was this bad......)
So you came here too, Yui...
Yui...
It's fine, don't worry about it.
rows.notes: Shared: female player to Yui (nml_yui_005) and Claire to the player (scd_com_716); works for both.

rows.en:
Yeah, that's it. You're way better when
you're full of energy, Yui.

(Even if she's only putting on a brave face,
that's better than being gloomy right now...)
(Phew~ The tests are finally over~)
Uuuuugh~......
(Whoa, there's somebody lying dead over there...)
Hoshimura... Was it really that bad?
Don't ask... don't ask me anything right now......
(It must've been really bad...)

Ha ha ha ha ha!!
No use staying down in the dumps forever!
Tests are over, so all that's left is fun!
All right! Let's go out and have a blast~!
Ah, Hoshimura...
(Hoshimura's finally escaped from reality...)
(Whoa, there's somebody lying dead over there...)
Yui... Was it really that bad?
(Looks like it was really bad...)
Ah, Yui...
(Yui's finally escaped from reality...)

(Lunchtime at last.
What should I eat today...)

Yo~, \p!
Whatcha gonna do for lunch today?

I haven't decided yet...
What are you going to eat, Hoshimura?

I haven't decided yet either.
Well, since we're both here, let's eat together.

Sure, let's.
Hoshimura, is there any food you don't like?

Hmm... Food I don't like, huh......
Food I don't like...
Hmmm............

(I didn't think I'd asked a question
hard enough to agonize over like that...)

Yup! I thought it over real hard, and
I don't think there's any food I hate.

Being picky is such a waste, after all.
If it's edible, you gotta eat it!
So, can you even eat really bizarre food?

Easy-peasy!
Once you're at Yui-san's level, stuff like that
goes down in a single bite, I tell ya.

(She's not just bluffing. Hoshimura really
would eat it without a second thought...)

(Lunchtime at last.
What should I eat today...)

I haven't decided yet...
What are you going to eat, Yui?

Sure, let's.
Yui, is there any food you don't like?

(She's not just bluffing. Yui really
would eat it without a second thought...)

uncertain: c20020: Yui's misunderstanding (she thinks the male player sneaked out to buy something racy) kept as implied as in the Japanese.
c20013: 'sensei ni chikuccha o' -> 'tattle to Sensei' (unnamed teacher).
c20050: shared by the female player (to Yui) and Claire (scd_com_716); neutral 'It's fine, don't worry about it.'
